description: Vivo may launch the T5 Pro in India soon, with leaks pointing to a mid-April debut. The handset is expected to be priced just above Rs. 30,000, placing it in the competitive mid-range segment. It may feature a 6.8-inch 1.5K AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate and run on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset. The device is also tipped to include a 50-megapixel camera, a large 9,020mAh battery with 90W charging, and IP68 and IP69+ ratings.
title: Vivo T5 Pro Price in India, Launch Timeline Leaked Online Ahead of Expected Debut

description: Google, on Thursday, announced two major updates to its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered live features. The Mountain View-based tech giant is now expanding Search Live globally, allowing users to receive relevant answers to their search queries using the Gemini assistant. Additionally, Gemini Live, the real-time conversational experience inside the Gemini app, is also getting an upgrade and will now be powered by the Gemini 3.1 Flash Live AI model.
title: Google Upgrades Gemini Live With Faster and Smarter Responses, Expands Search Live Globally

description: Switching phones, especially between iOS and Android ecosystems, is often a hassle. The biggest headache is usually ensuring your WhatsApp account is properly migrated without any loss of data. However, WhatsApp has now announced support for seamless cross-platform chat transfer, allowing users to move their conversations, photos, and videos between operating systems.  With just a few steps, your entire WhatsApp history can move with you when switching devices.
title: How to Transfer WhatsApp Chats From iOS to Android: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Samsung launched its Galaxy S26 series with the One UI 8.5 pre-installed. Now, the company is preparing for the release of s One UI 8.5  to older flagships. ahead of its public release, the beta version One UI 8.5 made its way to Galaxy S24 series, Galaxy Z Fold 6, Galaxy Z Flip 6, Galaxy S25 FE, Galaxy S24 FE and Galaxy Tab S11 in select markets including the UK, India, Korea and the US.
title: Samsung Opens One UI 8.5 Beta to More Galaxy Devices, Including Galaxy S24 and Galaxy Z Fold 6

description: Bitcoin traded near $69,000 on March 26 as weak sentiment and macro uncertainty weighed on markets. Analysts highlighted resistance near $70,000–$72,000 and support around $67,500, keeping prices range-bound. ETF flows remain uneven, while rising stablecoin supply signals capital on the sidelines. Experts said markets are awaiting clearer macro triggers before the next move.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $69,000 as Weak Sentiment Keeps Crypto Market in Check

description: Motorola may launch the Razr 70 series with two models, the Razr 70 and Razr 70 Ultra. While the standard model has already appeared on certification platforms, new leaks reveal the Ultra variant through CAD renders and a 360-degree video. The design appears largely unchanged, with a 7-inch inner and 4-inch cover display. The phone could be slightly thicker than its predecessor, likely due to hardware upgrades. It is expected to debut in China before expanding globally and may launch as the Razr Ultra 2026 in the US.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra Design and Dimensions Revealed via Leaked CAD Renders

description: The Android 17 Beta 3 is being rolled out by Google, with a mix of visible changes and under-the-hood updates. The Mountain View-based tech giant is testing several new features that are not yet available to public users. According to a report, one of them is a Priority Charging feature. This is aimed at speeding up charging by limiting background activity. Meanwhile, Google has also confirmed support for vendor-defined camera extensions.
title: Android 17 Beta 3 Hints at New Priority Charging Feature, OEM-Exclusive Camera Features in Third-Party Apps: Report

description: Oppo has opened pre-orders for the K15 Pro series in China. The Oppo K15 Pro and Oppo K15 Pro+ are confirmed to be available in 256GB and 512GB storage options with 12GB RAM as standard. The Oppo K15 Pro will include a 7,500mAh battery, while the Oppo K15 Pro+ will have an 8,000mAh battery with 100W charging support. Additionally, the Oppo K15 Pro smartphones appeared on the Geekbench platform, revealing their possible model number and specifications.
title: Oppo K15 Pro, Oppo K15 Pro+ Colourways, Battery and Storage Details Revealed as Smartphone Visits Geekbench

description: Instagram has announced the launch of the new Dhurandhar: The Revenge-inspired custom font style for the Edits app. This will allow users to create Reels with the new text font, imitating the newly released Aditya Dhar-directed and Ranveer Singh-starrer film. Capitalising on the movie’s popularity in the country, which has collected more than Rs. 1,000 crore at the box office globally, the new font style is currently available in India in the text tool of the Edits app on devices running both Android and iOS.
title: Instagram’s Edits App Updated With Font Inspired By Dhurandhar: The Revenge; Developer Spots Offline Viewing Feature

description: Redmi 15A has been launched in India. It comes in three colourways with a dual rear camera unit. The Redmi 15A has a 6,300mAh battery and an octa-core chipset under the hood. It has a starting price tag of Rs. 12,999 for the base variant with 4GB RAM + 64GB storage. It will be available for purchase in India from April 3.
title: Redmi 15A Launched in India With Dual Rear Cameras, 6,300mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI’s Adult Mode feature for ChatGPT is reportedly facing another hurdle. As per the report, the feature, which will let users have explicit conversations of a sexual nature with the artificial intelligence (AI) chatbot, is being put on hold indefinitely. The decision was reportedly made after several staff members and investors raised concerns.
title: OpenAI Reportedly Shelves ChatGPT’s Adult Mode Plans Indefinitely

description: Meta may be preparing new Ray-Ban AI smart glasses, as FCC filings referenced in a recent newsletter point to two models called Ray-Ban Meta Scriber and Blazer. The filings suggest the devices are final units, indicating a possible near-term launch. Details remain limited, but features like a charging case, new model numbers, and Wi-Fi 6 support have surfaced. Strong sales growth has boosted Meta’s confidence, as it expands its wearable lineup while scaling back parts of its virtual reality business.
title: Meta Ray-Ban Scriber, Blazer Smart Glasses Listed on US FCC Database With Wi-Fi 6 Support: Report

description: Google on Friday announced new tools for the Gemini app, which make it easier for users to migrate from other artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots. The new features were previously reported to be in testing last month. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, it allows importing of personal context, preferences, and even full chat histories from competing services into Gemini. This move is expected to reduce the friction of starting fresh with a new assistant.
title: Google Makes Switching to Gemini Easier With Chat Transfer, Memory Import Tools

description: Apple has delisted the Mac Pro from its website globally, including India, officially halting the sales of the flagship desktop through its online store. The Cupertino-based tech giant has also confirmed that it is discontinuing the Apple Silicon M2 Ultra-powered Mac Pro to 9to5Mac. The desktop was launched by the iPhone-maker in June 2023, along with the M2-powered 15-inch MacBook Air and Mac Studio (2023). Now, the company only sells the new iMac, Mac Mini, and Mac Studio with M4, up to M4 Pro, and up to M4 Max processors, respectively.
title: Apple's Mac Pro Desktop With M2 Ultra Chipset Discontinued Nearly Three Years After Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Ultra has been launched in India as its latest flagship laptop, along with the Galaxy Book 6 Pro and the standard Galaxy Book 6. The new laptops are scheduled to go on sale in the country via the Samsung India online store and other offline retail channels. All three laptops are powered by the latest Intel Panther Lake processors, featuring up to an Intel Core Ultra X7 Series 3 processor. The Galaxy Book 6 Ultra and Galaxy Book 6 Pro are offered in a single gray colourway, while the standard Galaxy Book 6 will go on sale in India in Gray and Silver colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy Book 6 Ultra, Galaxy Book 6 Pro Launched in India, Galaxy Book 6 Tags Along: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung may launch a wider version of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 alongside the standard model, according to recent leaks. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide is said to feature a significantly broader unfolded design, measuring up to 161.4mm in width, making it around 18mm wider than the regular variant. It could also adopt a 3:4 aspect ratio, similar to a tablet, improving multitasking and media use. The wider form factor may also affect portability.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide Leak Reveals Much Bigger, Tablet-Like Design

description: Apple’s long-rumoured foldable iPhone has been rumoured for years. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman now says it won’t actually ship to customers alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in that same timeframe. The foldable model is said to come with a 7.8-inch internal display and a 5.5-inch external screen. It is said to feature dual cameras on both the front and back, and a Touch ID sensor built into the power button. It could come with an A20 Pro chip.
title: Apple's iPhone Fold Likely to Ship Later Than iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max: Mark Gurman

description: RCS (Rich Communication Services) Universal Profile 4.0 has been introduced by the Global System for Mobile Communications Association (GSMA) as the latest messaging standard, GSMA’s Technical Director Tom Van Pelt announced on Thursday. The latest RCS profile brings multiple new features, which might soon come to various RCS-based messaging apps. The RCS Universal Profile 4.0 will soon bring native video calls support, which will let users switch from text-based messaging to video calls within a chat window.
title: RCS Universal Profile 4.0 Will Bring Native Video Call and Rich Text Support to Messaging Apps

description: WhatsApp on Thursday announced a new set of features that are aimed at improving cross-platform functionality, organisation, and usability. As per the Meta-owned instant messaging app, new tools are rolling out for managing storage, transferring chats between Android and iOS devices, and improving conversations with AI features. iPhone users can now also maintain two accounts on a single device — a functionality which was previously exclusive to Android.
title: WhatsApp Announces Big Update; Rolls Out Cross-Platform Chat Transfer Tool, Dual Accounts on iOS and More

description: Apple is said to be planning a major change to its artificial intelligence (AI) strategy. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant could open up Siri to third-party AI assistants, moving beyond the current ChatGPT exclusivity. The changes, expected to arrive with iOS 27, are reported to be an attempt to bring about a turnaround in Apple’s fortunes in the AI space, where it currently lags behind its Silicon Valley peers.
title: Apple to Reportedly Open Up Siri to Gemini, Claude and More Third-Party AI Assistants With iOS 27
